# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Upgraded all four source-water presets to carry differentiated carbonate-relevant inputs (DIC and alkalinity) that produce meaningfully different equilibrium pH values under the carbonate solver. hard_shrimp: KH 8, DIC 35.7 mg C/L, Alk 2.856 meq/L → pH ~7.72. moderate: KH 4, DIC 19.4 mg C/L, Alk 1.428 meq/L → pH ~7.23. soft_acidic: KH 2, DIC 12.1 mg C/L, Alk 0.714 meq/L → pH ~6.75. ro_like: KH 0.1, DIC 1.2 mg C/L, Alk 0.036 meq/L → pH ~6.11 (was all-zero with neutral fallback pH 7.0). Updated provenance notes in each TOML with plain-language descriptions of what each profile emulates, including equilibrium pH range and buffering character. Added 8 tests covering DIC presence, alkalinity ordering, water-change dilution math for DIC and alkalinity, pH differentiation (>0.5 pH gap between soft and hard), RO buffering reduction, validation rejection of negative/NaN inputs, and a 500-hour integration test comparing soft vs hard tanks under feeding.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Updated hard_shrimp.toml: DIC 22→35.7, Alk 1.785→2.856 (KH 5→8), bicarbonate display 108.9→174.2, updated provenance notes with Sulawesi-type description and equilibrium pH ~7.72
2. [Completed] Updated moderate.toml: DIC 18→19.4, Alk 1.249→1.428 (KH 3.5→4), bicarbonate display 76.2→87.1, updated provenance notes with municipal tap water description and equilibrium pH ~7.2
3. [Completed] Updated soft_acidic.toml: DIC 24→12.1, Alk 1.07→0.714 (KH 3→2), bicarbonate display 65.3→43.6, updated provenance notes with blackwater/soft Asian tap description and equilibrium pH ~6.75
4. [Completed] Updated ro_like.toml: DIC 0→1.2, Alk 0→0.036 (KH 0→0.1), added Ca/Mg/Na/K/Cl/SO4 for remineralized RO (GH ~3.5), updated provenance notes with RO/DI remineralized description and equilibrium pH ~6.1
5. [Completed] Added tank_data as dev-dependency in tank_core/Cargo.toml for test preset loading
6. [Completed] Created crates/tank_core/tests/source_water_carbonate.rs with 8 tests: test_source_water_carries_dic, test_source_water_carries_alkalinity, test_water_change_brings_source_dic, test_water_change_brings_source_alkalinity, test_differentiated_source_waters_produce_different_ph, test_ro_water_minimal_buffering, test_source_water_validation, test_source_water_ph_story
7. [Completed] Verified all 8 new tests pass, all existing tests pass (except pre-existing failure in happy_plants_grow_with_light_and_nutrients), clippy clean, fmt clean

## Validation Evidence

- All 8 source_water_carbonate tests pass: test_source_water_carries_dic, test_source_water_carries_alkalinity, test_water_change_brings_source_dic, test_water_change_brings_source_alkalinity, test_differentiated_source_waters_produce_different_ph, test_ro_water_minimal_buffering, test_source_water_validation, test_source_water_ph_story
- All 32 tank_data preset tests pass (shipped_param_meta_loaders_return_no_diagnostics confirms all presets load and validate without diagnostics)
- All tank_core tests pass except pre-existing failure happy_plants_grow_with_light_and_nutrients (confirmed pre-existing via git stash test on clean HEAD)
- Equilibrium pH differentiation verified: hard_shrimp (~7.72) - soft_acidic (~6.75) = ~0.97 pH units > 0.5 threshold
- Integration test verified: after 500 hours with feeding, soft_acidic tank has lower pH than hard_shrimp tank, soft water shows greater pH decline (less buffering)
- cargo clippy --tests produces no warnings on new test file
- cargo fmt --check passes on all modified files

## Outstanding Risks

- Pre-existing test failure: happy_plants_grow_with_light_and_nutrients in end_to_end.rs was already failing before this change (confirmed via git stash test on clean HEAD). Not caused by this task.
- e2e baseline scenario envelope tests in tank_harness may need tightening in task 6e5.4.6 (Add carbonate regression tests) since source water chemistry has shifted. Current wide envelope bounds (pH 5.0-9.0) still pass.
- The ro_like profile is no longer all-zeros. Tests that construct SourceWaterProfile::zero() directly (e.g. water_change_mass_balance) are unaffected, but any code that assumed the ro_like TOML preset had zero DIC/alkalinity would see different behavior.
